name: Chilli Paneer Dry
steps: Cube paneer and mix plain flour, 30 g starch and 60 ml water into a light batter. Toss paneer in the batter.
Heat 40 ml oil in a wide non-stick pan and shallow-fry paneer for 2–3 minutes per side until lightly crisp. Transfer to a plate.
Mix soy sauce, ketchup, chilli sauce, vinegar and sugar. Mix the remaining starch separately with 40 ml cold water.
Heat remaining oil and stir-fry minced ginger and garlic for 30 seconds. Add capsicum and onion squares and toss for 3–4 minutes.
Add the sauce mixture and remaining water, bring to a simmer, then stir in the starch slurry and cook for 2–3 minutes until thick enough to coat the vegetables.
Return paneer and toss gently for 1–2 minutes. Finish with spring onion and serve immediately; taste before adding salt because the sauces already contain it.
tips: Cook one test piece first to check seasoning, binding and cooking temperature before finishing the batch.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
